aiEngines.heroDescription: Bring your own API key (BYOK). It stays on your device and is never stored by Pastek Art.
aiEngines.intro: Without a personal key, the app uses the free mode (Hugging Face) or the local fallback. With a key, you choose the model — Pastek Art only relays the request and never keeps the key.

mistral.why: Fluent models for briefs and the creative mirror, strong in French and English.

scaleway.why: European generative API (OpenAI-compatible). Use a Scaleway IAM secret key (SCW_SECRET_KEY), not a public one. Common serverless models (Llama 3.3, Mistral Small, Gemma) are tried automatically.

ovhcloud.why: OVHcloud AI Endpoints (OpenAI-compatible). Create a token under Public Cloud → AI Endpoints. Current catalog model IDs and legacy aliases are tried automatically.

alephalpha.why: European LLM (Germany). Create a token at app.aleph-alpha.com. The app tries chat/completions then Complete, across several Luminous / Pharia models.

ollama.why: A model on your own machine — no cloud key. Give the service URL (e.g. http://192.168.x.x:11434). With a hosted API (Vercel), Ollama must be reachable from the server (tunnel / public IP), not just your phone's localhost. Pull a model: ollama pull llama3.2

cohere.why: Canadian LLM (Toronto). Create a key at dashboard.cohere.com — Command A (multilingual FR/EN) with optional vision.

openai.why: A versatile text / image option if you already have an account.

anthropic.why: Claude Haiku 4.5 / Sonnet 5 — excellent at looking at a piece with nuance, without aesthetic judgement.

gemini.why: Current Gemini models (3.5 Flash, with 3.6 / 3.1 Lite as fallback). Use an AI Studio key without HTTP/IP restrictions — Pastek relays from the server.

prompts.heroDescription: The system instructions that guide the AI. Edit them on your device — they are never stored on our servers.
prompts.intro: Left untouched, Pastek Art uses the gentle prompts below. Your own versions replace only the system text (exercise, mirror, photo reading, OCR).

auth.title: Secure your Creative Thread

auth.intro: Sign in with no password. Your traces stay on this device until the first sync.
auth.footer: Free · no credit card · no commitment
auth.callbackFailedBody: Sign-in did not complete. Try Google again, or request a new magic link.
auth.callbackFailedHint: Go back to Settings to sign in again.
auth.errorProviderDisabled:
{{label}} is not enabled in your Supabase project.

Dashboard → Authentication → Providers → turn it on.

In the meantime, use the email magic link.
auth.errorInvalidApiKey:
Invalid or incomplete Supabase key.

In Vercel (API project), paste the full anon key from Supabase → Project Settings → API (it starts with eyJhbGci...).
auth.errorFlowExpired:
The Google session expired during the redirect.

Try again from https://pastek-art.eu (without www), then pick your Google account again.
